title: Ah, Dedalus, the Greeks! I must teach you. You must read them in the original.
html_source:
Joyce never learned to read Ancient Greek, at least with any fluency.

Also see Mulligan’s mention of Athens just above.

anchor.text: Ah, Dedalus, the Greeks! I must teach you. You must read them in the original.
